one_liner: San Antonio scored 119.8 points per game in the latest season -- third-highest in this manifest -- while its minutes leader posted only a 27 PRA-per-36 rate.
three_things: 119.8 points per game with no single player dominating the box score.
Devin Vassell led in minutes (6,213.1) at 27 PRA per 36.
Tempo was ordinary at a 102 pace proxy, so the scoring is distribution, not pace.
context_note: The 'top contributor' is the player with the most total minutes for that team across the 3-season sample, not necessarily its best or highest-scoring player. PRA-per-36 sums points, rebounds, and assists per 36 minutes -- a raw box rate, not an impact metric. ppg_latest_season and pace_proxy_latest_season are single-season figures while games_total spans three seasons, and pace_proxy is a proxy, not official possession-based pace. The manifest is descriptive_only, with no schedule, opponent, or roster-continuity adjustment. League-wide rank statements were computed by sorting all 30 teams in this manifest on the named field; the underlying values are read verbatim.
